strings.text: The school’s live site no longer enumerates its own affinity groups. strings.text: The first independent school in the country to host a Children’s Defense Fund Freedom School — and still the only one running it every summer.

strings.text: A summer literacy program for K–8 Charlotte scholars, run with Freedom School Partners. Providence Day was the first independent school in the country to host a CDF Freedom School. Li toujou sèl la k ap òganize yon pwogram chak ete. Kominote lekòl la ranmase materyèl pou tout 18 sit Charlotte yo.

strings.text: The school also advertises over 30 student-run service clubs. Each division has its own partnership: 6th grade with Movement School · 7th with Winterfield Elementary · 8th with Wilson STEM Academy · a 9th-grade Charger Impact Challenge. The school has no community service requirement.
strings.t: Lekòl la fè piblisite tou pou plis pase 30 klib sèvis elèv yo dirije. Chak divizyon gen pwòp patenarya pa l: grad 6 ak Movement School · grad 7 ak Winterfield Elementary · grad 8 ak Wilson STEM Academy · yon Charger Impact Challenge pou grad 9. Lekòl la pa egzije sèvis kominotè.

strings.text: The grade-level partnerships and the Charger Impact Challenge are part of the curriculum rather than clubs. The President’s Volunteer Service Award is an award for a student’s own logged hours, not a membership. The Community Engagement Portal is a tool that lists service opportunities. The catalog card lists only confirmed organizations.
strings.t: Patenarya nivo grad yo ak Charger Impact Challenge la fè pati kourikoulòm nan, yo pa klib. President’s Volunteer Service Award la se yon prim pou pwòp èdtan yon elèv anrejistre, se pa yon manbraj. Community Engagement Portal la se yon zouti ki liste opòtinite sèvis. Kat katalòg la liste sèlman òganizasyon konfime.

strings.text: There is no standing honor-societies page. Every fact here comes from one-off news posts, so the published counts are historical rather than current, except the 2026–27 profile’s 118 NHS inductees — 89 NHS inductees in 2017, 34 Cum Laude members in 2022, nearly 50 art inductees one May, 11 Tri-M inductees in 2019. Induction criteria are published only for the National Honor Society; the other four publish none.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn paj pèmanan sou sosyete onè yo. Chak enfòmasyon isit la soti nan piblikasyon nouvèl izole, kidonk kantite ki pibliye yo se istorik olye ke aktyèl, eksepte 118 nouvo manm NHS ki nan pwofil 2026–27 la — 89 nouvo manm NHS an 2017, 34 manm Cum Laude an 2022, prèske 50 nouvo manm nan atizay yon mwa me, 11 nouvo manm Tri-M an 2019. Kritè admisyon pibliye sèlman pou National Honor Society la; kat lòt yo pa pibliye okenn.

strings.text: No Middle School honor society could be confirmed, and despite five world languages on offer only the French society is evidenced. Archive searches across the site’s full URL history for Rho Kappa, Mu Alpha Theta, Quill & Scroll, a junior honor society and a Spanish society returned nothing.
strings.t: Nou pa t kapab konfime okenn sosyete onè Middle School, epi malgre senk lang etranje yo ofri, se sèlman sosyete franse a ki gen prèv. Rechèch nan achiv sou tout istwa URL sit la pou Rho Kappa, Mu Alpha Theta, Quill & Scroll, yon sosyete onè jinyò ak yon sosyete panyòl pa t bay anyen.

strings.t: Komite DEI pa divizyon pou pwofesè ak anplwaye · Sesyon Aprantisaj Edikasyon DEI pou Paran · Parent Cookbook Club la, ki “transfòme modèl klib liv tipik la an yon eksperyans kiltirèl imèsif… k ap eksplore kilti divès yon bèl resèt alafwa.” Okenn nan sa yo se pa yon gwoup afinite ki baze sou idantite.

strings.text: The DEI page describes "the student-led Diversity Club and Alliance Groups" in a single sentence and links to a "Diversity Club List" — but that link leads to a page containing no list. No affinity group count is published anywhere, so unlike its peers there are no rival numbers to reconcile; there is simply no roster. No Lower or Middle School groups are published, and no student diversity leadership corps or national conference attendance appears anywhere on the site.
strings.t: Paj DEI a dekri “Diversity Club la ak Alliance Groups elèv yo dirije” nan yon sèl fraz epi li mete yon lyen sou yon “Diversity Club List” — men lyen sa a mennen nan yon paj ki pa gen okenn lis. Pa gen okenn kantite gwoup afinite ki pibliye okenn kote, kidonk kontrèman ak lekòl parèy li yo pa gen chif rival pou rekonsilye; senpleman pa gen lis. Pa gen okenn gwoup Lower oswa Middle School ki pibliye, e pa gen okenn kò lidèchip divèsite elèv ni patisipasyon nan konferans nasyonal ki parèt okenn kote sou sit la.

strings.text: Service is deliberately not required — and students still logged 3,396 hours by the end of junior year, with a recognition society and a national first behind them.
strings.t: Sèvis la se espre yo pa egzije l — epi elèv yo te toujou anrejistre 3,396 èdtan anvan fen twazyèm ane a, ak yon sosyete rekonesans ak yon premye nasyonal dèyè yo.

strings.text: The school states plainly that it has no service-hours graduation requirement; what it has instead is a reflection-based recognition model running across all four Upper School years.
strings.t: Lekòl la di klèman li pa gen okenn kondisyon èdtan sèvis pou gradyasyon; sa li genyen olye a se yon modèl rekonesans ki baze sou refleksyon k ap kouri atravè tout kat ane Upper School yo.

strings.text: A recognition society, not a requirement. It "recognizes students who make significant contributions to the community through service" and uses a reflection-based model across all four Upper School years. Four-year students need 150 hours, with the total reduced in proportion for transfer students. Qualifying students are inducted at the end of senior year.
strings.t: Yon sosyete rekonesans, se pa yon kondisyon. Li “rekonèt elèv ki fè kontribisyon enpòtan nan kominote a atravè sèvis” epi li sèvi ak yon modèl ki baze sou refleksyon pandan tout kat ane Upper School yo. Elèv kat ane bezwen 150 èdtan, epi total la redwi an pwopòsyon pou elèv transfè. Elèv ki kalifye yo antre nan sosyete a nan fen dènye ane a.

strings.text: Charlotte Latin is "the first private or independent school in the country with a senior class that funded and built a Habitat for Humanity House." The community has since funded and built four, and regularly assists with builds locally and in El Salvador.

strings.text: Three school-wide partners anchor the program: Baby Bundles, Special Olympics and Habitat for Humanity of the Charlotte Region. The program follows six Principles of Good Practice. Every week of the year, the Upper School Service Council organizes service activities students can join.

strings.text: The school lists Blessings in a Backpack and Student Council apart from its club roster. It treats both as standing activities rather than open-enrollment clubs. strings.text: A nine-member prefect system: student leaders mentored by faculty. The roles are Head · Academic · Admissions · Athletic · Global Awareness · Fine Arts · Service · Spiritual Life · Student Life. The Global Awareness Prefect is the identity and global leadership role. The Service Prefect is the civic one.
strings.t: Yon sistèm prefè nèf manm: lidè elèv pwofesè ap mentore. Wòl yo se Head · Academic · Admissions · Athletic · Global Awareness · Fine Arts · Service · Spiritual Life · Student Life. Global Awareness Prefect la se wòl lidèchip idantite ak mondyal la. Service Prefect la se wòl sivik la.

strings.text: The school runs two overlapping global/cultural student groups and never reconciles them. The Diversity & Belonging page names only Global Knights; the Knights Headlines feature names only Knights Nations Club; and the Upper School clubs list names neither, omitting both from its 13-club roster. The count of global/cultural groups therefore reads as none, one or two depending which page you open, and no page publishes a total.
strings.t: Lekòl la fè de gwoup elèv mondyal/kiltirèl ki sipèpoze epi li pa janm rekonsilye yo. Paj Diversity & Belonging la nonmen sèlman Global Knights; atik Knights Headlines la nonmen sèlman Knights Nations Club; epi lis klib Upper School la pa nonmen ni youn ni lòt, li kite tou de deyò nan lis 13 klib li a. Kantite gwoup mondyal/kiltirèl la kidonk li kòm zewo, youn oswa de depann de ki paj ou louvri, epi okenn paj pa pibliye yon total.

strings.text: No affinity groups by race, ethnicity, gender, religion or orientation exist anywhere on the site, and no Middle or Lower School cultural groups — those divisions get programming only. No membership counts, meeting schedules or faculty sponsors are published for any of the three groups, and Global Knights has no page of its own.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn gwoup afinite pa ras, etnisite, sèks, relijyon oswa oryantasyon okenn kote sou sit la, e pa gen okenn gwoup kiltirèl Middle oswa Lower School — divizyon sa yo jwenn pwogramasyon sèlman. strings.text: Winterim trips are a graduation requirement and a travel program. Kingdom Impact Day is a service day for a whole division. The Multicultural Festival is a yearly all-school event. strings.t: Vwayaj Winterim yo se yon kondisyon pou gradyasyon ak yon pwogram vwayaj. Kingdom Impact Day se yon jounen sèvis pou tout yon divizyon. Multicultural Festival la se yon evènman chak ane pou tout lekòl la. Sèvis Cross-Cultural Communications la se yon klas k ap fè sèvis. Vocational Shadowing ak Alternative Winterim Experience yo ranje pou chak elèv, atravè fanmi an. Okenn nan yo se pa yon klib.

strings.text: The Winterim packet states that the program "does not count toward additional requirements for conservatory or service hours" — proving a separate service-hours expectation exists. Yet no numeric hours target is published anywhere on the site, along with no participation percentage, no total hours, and no founding year for Knights Serve. The Knights Serve page advertises 2025-26 service projects with no detail behind the heading.
strings.t: Pakè Winterim la deklare pwogram nan “pa konte pou kondisyon adisyonèl pou konsèvatwa oswa èdtan sèvis” — sa ki pwouve yon atant èdtan sèvis apa egziste. Poutan pa gen okenn objektif nimerik èdtan ki pibliye okenn kote sou sit la, ansanm ak pa gen pousantaj patisipasyon, pa gen total èdtan, e pa gen ane fondasyon pou Knights Serve. Paj Knights Serve la fè piblisite pou pwojè sèvis 2025-26 san okenn detay dèyè tit la.

strings.text: The school publishes nothing beyond the five names — no induction criteria, no GPA threshold, no chapter activities, advisors, officers, meeting information or current membership counts, and no dedicated honor-societies page. strings.text: The clubs directory sits under Campus Ministry, not student activities, and that shapes the mix. strings.text: The school profile says CCHS "encourages all students to participate in school-sponsored clubs". The directory publishes advisors and rooms but no application process, no membership caps and no meeting schedule. So the school does not say how selective any club is, if at all.

strings.text: The 2025-26 school profile says "over 50 club opportunities"; the clubs directory enumerates 76. Both are the school’s own figures. The directory is the countable one and is what this app reports.

strings.text: What this means for a family
strings.t: Sa sa vle di pou yon fanmi

strings.text: Every graduate completes 70 hours. So service hours do not set one CCHS applicant apart from another. What sets students apart for a college reader is the parish requirement and the leadership roles behind the hours. A family should also note the practical load: 20 hours a year from sophomore year, with a hard March 1 cutoff, on top of a seven-class schedule.

Yon fanmi ta dwe note chay pratik la tou: 20 èdtan pa ane apati dezyèm ane a, ak yon dat limit fiks 1ye mas, anwo yon orè sèt kou.

strings.text: Induction criteria are published for five of the ten societies. The four world-language societies and the National Art Honor Society are named on the school profile without a stated GPA or points threshold, and no society publishes its membership count.

strings.text: CCHS runs a school newspaper, a literary magazine, a yearbook and a podcast. But they run as ENGLISH COURSES (Journalism 234 and Yearbook 235), not as clubs, which is why none appears in the 76-club directory. Both are year-long electives for grades 10–12. Each requires a B average in English and a teacher recommendation. Yearbook also requires an application and an interview.
strings.t: CCHS gen yon jounal lekòl, yon magazin literè, yon album ane ak yon podcast. Men yo fonksyone kòm KOU ENGLISH (Journalism 234 ak Yearbook 235), se pa kòm klib, se poutèt sa okenn nan yo pa parèt nan anyè 76 klib la. Tou de se elektif pou tout ane a pou klas 10–12. Chak mande yon mwayèn B nan English ak yon rekòmandasyon pwofesè. Yearbook mande tou yon aplikasyon ak yon entèvyou.

strings.text: Journalism (234) students produce and publish the school newspaper online. They also develop the school’s literary magazine, and they can choose to produce a podcast. strings.text: The Student Diversity Leadership Corps (SDLC) gives selected Middle and Upper Schoolers a formal role in the school's diversity work. Students also attend the national NAIS Student Diversity Leadership Conference. Country Day created and hosts the Affirming Community Together (ACT) Conference for area middle schoolers. The conference was first held in 2012. It grew out of Upper Schoolers wanting to pass on what they learned at national conferences. Since 1998 the school has sent two faculty from each division and six Upper School students to the NAIS People of Color Conference every year.
strings.t: Student Diversity Leadership Corps (SDLC) la bay elèv Middle ak Upper School ki chwazi yo yon wòl fòmèl nan travay divèsite lekòl la. Elèv yo ale tou nan NAIS Student Diversity Leadership Conference nasyonal la. Country Day te kreye epi li resevwa Affirming Community Together (ACT) Conference la pou elèv middle school nan zòn nan. Konferans lan te fèt pou premye fwa an 2012. Li te soti nan elèv Upper School ki te vle pataje sa yo te aprann nan konferans nasyonal yo. Depi 1998 lekòl la voye de pwofesè nan chak divizyon ak sis elèv Upper School nan NAIS People of Color Conference chak ane.

strings.text: Three official pages disagree. A DEIB stat tile advertises 22 affinity groups; the DEIB program page enumerates 15 by name (9 Upper, 5 Middle, 1 Lower). We show the 15 that are named and flag the rest rather than silently picking one.
strings.t: Twa paj ofisyèl kontredi youn lòt. Yon mozayik estatistik DEIB fè piblisite pou 22 gwoup afinite; paj pwogram DEIB la nonmen 15 pa non (9 Upper, 5 Middle, 1 Lower). Tou de kantite pa divizyon yo pi ba pase pwòp lis pa yo tou — paj Student Life la di 7 gwoup Upper School kont 9 ki nonmen, epi paj Middle School la di kat kont senk. Nou montre 15 ki nonmen yo epi nou make rès la olye ke chwazi youn an silans.

strings.text: Public sources confirm the societies exist but not induction criteria — no GPA cutoff, class-rank percentile or service minimum is published for any of the six, and there is no dedicated honor-societies page. strings.text: A service project in which every senior works deeply on a charitable cause they care about. It ends in a presentation to faculty, staff, peers and community members, with time for reflection and questions. The school lists it among its Signature Learning Experiences.
strings.t: Yon pwojè sèvis kote chak elèv dènye ane travay an pwofondè sou yon kòz charitab li renmen. Li fini ak yon prezantasyon bay pwofesè, anplwaye, kanmarad ak manm kominote a, ak tan pou refleksyon ak kesyon. Lekòl la mete l pami Signature Learning Experiences li yo.

strings.text: A week-long hands-on program after winter break that "challenges students to think critically and practically, to serve others," with service options such as a Sea Island Habitat for Humanity trip and a food-bank week on hunger and food waste. The page names three tracks: the First & Second Year Experience (local community), the Junior Experience (professional skills) and Trips and Certifications. The school says the week is "broken into four experiences."
strings.t: Yon pwogram pratik yon semèn apre vakans divè a ki “defi elèv yo pou yo panse yon fason kritik ak pratik, pou yo sèvi lòt moun,” ak opsyon sèvis tankou yon vwayaj Sea Island Habitat for Humanity ak yon semèn nan yon bank manje sou grangou ak gaspiyaj manje. Paj la nonmen twa pis: First & Second Year Experience (kominote lokal), Junior Experience (konpetans pwofesyonèl) ak Trips and Certifications. Lekòl la di semèn nan “divize an kat eksperyans.”

strings.text: In the Middle School

strings.text: Each grade follows a service-learning model (learning through service projects). Students research topics, find needs in teams and build action plans. strings.text: Every Diploma Distinction requires an immersive practicum (a hands-on learning experience) of at least 100 hours. It can be one of these: an internship · civic engagement · nonprofit leadership · medical shadowing · a pre-college program. Each distinction also requires Ethics Labs every quarter and a capstone at the Davidson Day Scholars Research Conference. Students apply at the end of sophomore year. Outside the distinctions, the school’s 2026–27 profile states that “Service is encouraged, but not required.”

strings.text: Davidson Day is the first high school ever to work with the program. Thirteen Upper Schoolers completed two deliberation modules, on social safety nets and on constitutional rights. The students went to expert panels and two-hour small-group talks. The talks were built around respectful discussion rather than debating to win.
strings.t: Davidson Day se premye lekòl segondè ki janm travay ak pwogram nan. Trèz elèv Upper School te konplete de modil deliberasyon, sou rezo sekirite sosyal ak sou dwa konstitisyonèl. Elèv yo te ale nan panèl ekspè ak diskisyon de èdtan an ti gwoup. Diskisyon yo te bati sou yon echanj ak respè olye ke deba pou genyen.

strings.text: Two of the school’s most striking service stories are explicitly not clubs. Longevity LKN is a student-founded 501(c)(3) nonprofit, not a school club. The nonprofit has screened over 100 community members for blood pressure across Lake Norman. In the AFAR archaeology work, 13 students excavated the Adam Spach Rock House alongside professional archaeologists. Those students were the first high schoolers to work with the North Carolina State Historic Preservation Office. The school’s own page never defines that work as a club. The Deliberative Citizenship partnership is a structured program, and Patriot Pals is a peer-mentorship tradition.
strings.t: De nan istwa sèvis lekòl la ki pi frapan yo eksplisitman se pa klib. Longevity LKN se yon òganizasyon san bi likratif 501(c)(3) elèv yo fonde, se pa yon klib lekòl. Òganizasyon an fè tès tansyon pou plis pase 100 manm kominote a atravè Lake Norman. Nan travay akeyoloji AFAR la, 13 elèv te fouye Adam Spach Rock House la ansanm ak akeyològ pwofesyonèl. Elèv sa yo te premye elèv lekòl segondè ki travay ak North Carolina State Historic Preservation Office. Pwòp paj lekòl la pa janm defini travay sa a kòm yon klib. Patenarya Deliberative Citizenship la se yon pwogram estriktire, epi Patriot Pals se yon tradisyon mentora ant kanmarad.

strings.text: The 100-hour practicum belongs to an opt-in diploma track, not a school-wide graduation requirement — and the school’s 2026–27 profile states plainly that “Service is encouraged, but not required.” No hour totals, partner counts or founding years accompany the Middle School program. Five of the six Community and Culture cards, including the Community Engagement Council, have no detail page behind them.
strings.t: Praktikòm 100 èdtan an fè pati yon pis diplòm opsyonèl, se pa yon kondisyon gradyasyon pou tout lekòl la — epi Pwofil 2026–27 lekòl la di klè: “Yo ankouraje sèvis, men li pa obligatwa.” Pa gen total èdtan, kantite patnè oswa ane fondasyon ki akonpaye pwogram Middle School la. Senk nan sis kat Community and Culture yo, ki enkli Community Engagement Council la, pa gen okenn paj detay dèyè yo.

strings.text: Service is a graduation requirement, not a club — 25 hours every year for every Upper School student, and a 40-hour Capstone every senior must complete.

strings.text: Every senior completes an approved internship, research or community-service project of no less than 40 hours. The project focuses either on preparing for a professional career or on advancing one of the school’s core values. It begins in the second semester of junior year and ends in the first semester of senior year. Students document and report on it throughout. The project carries 0.25 credit.
strings.t: Chak elèv dènye ane konplete yon estaj, yon rechèch oswa yon pwojè sèvis kominotè yo apwouve ki pa mwens pase 40 èdtan. Pwojè a konsantre swa sou preparasyon pou yon karyè pwofesyonèl swa sou avanse youn nan valè debaz lekòl la. Li kòmanse nan dezyèm semès onzyèm ane a epi li fini nan premye semès douzyèm ane a. Elèv yo dokimante l epi fè rapò sou li pandan tout tan an. Pwojè a vo 0.25 kredi.

Lyen yo fòme yo vin tounen yon pwogram mentoraj. Chak elèv onzyèm ak douzyèm ane kontinye rankontre epi travay ak elèv katriyèm ane l ap mentore a pandan tout ane eskolè a.

strings.text: All Upper School students must complete a minimum of 25 hours of volunteer service each year. The minimum rises to 40 hours for National Honor Society members. Juniors also plan, organize and carry out their own community-service project.
strings.t: Tout elèv Upper School dwe konplete yon minimòm de 25 èdtan sèvis volontè chak ane. Minimòm nan monte a 40 èdtan pou manm National Honor Society. Elèv onzyèm ane yo planifye, òganize epi egzekite pwòp pwojè sèvis kominotè pa yo tou.

strings.text: The recognition ladder above the requirement
strings.t: Nechèl rekonesans ki anwo egzijans lan

strings.text: Beyond the 25-hour floor, the President’s Service Award recognizes Upper School students who have served 100 or more hours. The Middle School runs its own Spartan Strong Volunteer Service Award at 50+ hours a year. So there is a documented ladder at three levels: 25 required · 50 recognized in the Middle School · 100 recognized in the Upper School. The 40-hour NHS threshold sits alongside it.
strings.t: Pi lwen pase planche 25 èdtan an, President’s Service Award la rekonèt elèv Upper School ki sèvi 100 èdtan oswa plis. Middle School la gen pwòp Spartan Strong Volunteer Service Award pa l a 50+ èdtan pa ane. Kidonk gen yon nechèl dokimante nan twa nivo: 25 egzije · 50 rekonèt nan Middle School la · 100 rekonèt nan Upper School la. Sèy 40 èdtan NHS la chita akote l.

strings.text: The Capstone and the 25-hour service obligation are graduation requirements rather than clubs. The card lists them because most Gaston Day service actually happens through them. The card also lists them because every graduate has one.

strings.text: Alongside the robotics club, Robotics (H) and Engineering (H) run as Upper School courses. A renovated makerspace supports them, with 3-D printers, laser cutters and CNC machines. On the club itself, the school's own profile states it plainly: "After years of operating a joint-school robotics team competing in FIRST Robotics where they placed 4th in state level competition, Gaston Day launched its own VEX Robotics Club and qualified for Technology Student Association VEX Nationals in 2023, the first year of joining the competition."

Sou klib la li menm, pwòp pwofil lekòl la di l klèman: “After years of operating a joint-school robotics team competing in FIRST Robotics where they placed 4th in state level competition, Gaston Day launched its own VEX Robotics Club and qualified for Technology Student Association VEX Nationals in 2023, the first year of joining the competition.”

strings.text: Eighth grade maps its community and researches an issue all year in the Social Issues Seminar. Then the class travels to Washington, DC to advocate on it. The 2024 group met Rep.
